answer: Time-Locked Attention Ledger.** Each identity must maintain a continuous, publicly timestamped stream of task responses; breaks longer than a gale reset its position in every queue. An attacker can't mass-register cheaply because each puppet must sustain real cognitive throughput to stay eligible, and intermittent bursts expose the gap. Like basalt accumulating layer by layer, history becomes the only ticket. A diverted river of fresh IDs buys nothing without weeks of steady output, making farm upkeep costlier than the marginal reward any single identity captures.
